# Generated by CppBuild from project.json. Do not edit: CppBuild rewrites this file.
# Solution ECOSTL: configure with cmake -S <this .cppbuild directory> -B <build directory>.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(ECOSTL LANGUAGES C CXX)
set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY CPPBUILD_FORMAT 2)  # checked by the including Solution

# Every member is added, with this Solution's linked Solutions, unless another CppBuild
# Solution includes this one (CPPBUILD_LINKED) and requests only the Projects it needs.
set(CPPBUILD_WHOLE_SOLUTION OFF)
if(PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL OR NOT CPPBUILD_LINKED)
  set(CPPBUILD_WHOLE_SOLUTION ON)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/CppBuildTopLevel.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "CppBuildTopLevel.cmake is missing; regenerate it with CppBuild (Solution.update)")
  endif()
  include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/CppBuildTopLevel.cmake")
endif()

# Each Project collects its sources when CMake runs, so adding or removing a file changes
# no generated file. CONFIGURE_DEPENDS checks the directories again at every build.
function(_cppbuild_collect_sources result modules)
  set(_files)
  set(_pending)
  foreach(_root IN LISTS ARGN)
    set(_root "${_cppbuild_project_dir}/${_root}")
    # Also notices a source directory created later.
    file(GLOB _found CONFIGURE_DEPENDS LIST_DIRECTORIES true "${_root}")
    if(IS_DIRECTORY "${_root}" AND NOT EXISTS "${_root}/.cppbuild-output.json")
      list(APPEND _pending "${_root}")
    endif()
  endforeach()
  while(_pending)
    list(POP_FRONT _pending _directory)
    # Glob patterns treat [ * ? specially; [[] [*] [?] match them literally.
    string(REPLACE "[" "[[]" _pattern "${_directory}")
    string(REPLACE "*" "[*]" _pattern "${_pattern}")
    string(REPLACE "?" "[?]" _pattern "${_pattern}")
    file(GLOB _children CONFIGURE_DEPENDS LIST_DIRECTORIES true "${_pattern}/*")
    foreach(_child IN LISTS _children)
      get_filename_component(_name "${_child}" NAME)
      if(IS_SYMLINK "${_child}")
        # Symbolic links and junctions are skipped, as by the scan.
      elseif(IS_DIRECTORY "${_child}")
        if(NOT _name MATCHES "^(\\.cppbuild|\\.git|build|__pycache__|\\.cache|\\.venv)$" AND NOT EXISTS "${_child}/.cppbuild-output.json")
          list(APPEND _pending "${_child}")
        endif()
      elseif(_name STREQUAL "CMakeLists.txt" OR _name STREQUAL "CppBuildTopLevel.cmake")
        file(STRINGS "${_child}" _first LIMIT_COUNT 1)
        if(NOT _first MATCHES "^# Generated by CppBuild")
          list(APPEND _files "${_child}")
        endif()
      else()
        list(APPEND _files "${_child}")
      endif()
    endforeach()
  endwhile()
  list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _files)
  list(SORT _files)
  # Only these suffixes are built; other files are listed for the IDE.
  set(_built "[cC]|[cC][cC]|[cC][pP][pP]|[cC][xX][xX]")
  if(WIN32)
    string(APPEND _built "|[dD][eE][fF]|[mM][aA][nN][iI][fF][eE][sS][tT]|[rR][cC]")
  endif()
  # Module interface units go to a file set instead of the plain sources.
  set(_modules ${_files})
  list(FILTER _modules INCLUDE REGEX "\\.([cC][cC][mM]|[cC][pP][pP][mM]|[cC][xX][xX][mM]|[iI][xX][xX]|[mM][pP][pP])$")
  list(FILTER _files EXCLUDE REGEX "\\.([cC][cC][mM]|[cC][pP][pP][mM]|[cC][xX][xX][mM]|[iI][xX][xX]|[mM][pP][pP])$")
  set(_display ${_files})
  list(FILTER _display EXCLUDE REGEX "\\.(${_built})$")
  if(_display)
    set_source_files_properties(${_display} PROPERTIES HEADER_FILE_ONLY TRUE)
  endif()
  set(${result} ${_files} PARENT_SCOPE)
  set(${modules} ${_modules} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(_cppbuild_module_scanning)
  get_property(_modules GLOBAL PROPERTY CPPBUILD_MODULE_TARGETS)
  if(NOT _modules)
    return()
  endif()
  get_property(_targets GLOBAL PROPERTY CPPBUILD_COMPILED_TARGETS)
  foreach(_target IN LISTS _targets)
    set(_pending ${_target})
    set(_seen)
    while(_pending)
      list(POP_FRONT _pending _item)
      if(NOT TARGET "${_item}")
        continue()
      endif()
      get_target_property(_aliased "${_item}" ALIASED_TARGET)
      if(_aliased)
        set(_item "${_aliased}")
      endif()
      if(_item IN_LIST _seen)
        continue()
      endif()
      list(APPEND _seen "${_item}")
      if(_item IN_LIST _modules)
        set_property(TARGET ${_target} PROPERTY CXX_SCAN_FOR_MODULES ON)
        break()
      endif()
      get_target_property(_links "${_item}" LINK_LIBRARIES)
      get_target_property(_interface "${_item}" INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES)
      foreach(_link IN LISTS _links _interface)
        if(_link AND NOT _link MATCHES "-NOTFOUND$")
          list(APPEND _pending "${_link}")
        endif()
      endforeach()
    endwhile()
  endforeach()
endfunction()

# ECOSTL: static_library, GUID 6610f855-4b8a-4f59-99cf-ac4f07a52119
if(CPPBUILD_WHOLE_SOLUTION OR DEFINED CPPBUILD_REQUEST_6610f8554b8a4f5999cfac4f07a52119)
  set(CPPBUILD_REQUESTED ${CPPBUILD_REQUEST_6610f8554b8a4f5999cfac4f07a52119})
  if(CPPBUILD_WHOLE_SOLUTION)
    list(APPEND CPPBUILD_REQUESTED STATIC)  # links within ECOSTL
    set(CMAKE_FOLDER "Projects")
  endif()
  add_subdirectory("projects/ECOSTL" "ECOSTL")
endif()

if(BUILD_TESTING AND (CPPBUILD_WHOLE_SOLUTION OR DEFINED CPPBUILD_REQUEST_acc73794cb1d423885fe1bebbb09f0c3))
  set(CPPBUILD_REQUESTED ${CPPBUILD_REQUEST_acc73794cb1d423885fe1bebbb09f0c3})
  if(CPPBUILD_WHOLE_SOLUTION)
    set(CMAKE_FOLDER "Projects")
  endif()
  add_subdirectory("projects/ECOSTLTest" "ECOSTLTest")
endif()

if(CPPBUILD_WHOLE_SOLUTION)
  # Every target of this build exists now, linked Solutions included.
  _cppbuild_module_scanning()
endif()

# Visual Studio starts the first program that exists (a TEST only with BUILD_TESTING);
# without it, F5 would start ALL_BUILD, the first project of the .sln.
if(CPPBUILD_WHOLE_SOLUTION)
  foreach(_cppbuild_startup IN ITEMS ECOSTL_ECOSTLTest)
    if(TARGET ${_cppbuild_startup})
      set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY VS_STARTUP_PROJECT ${_cppbuild_startup})
      break()
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()
